tagline: Ship real open source. Get hired for it.
brief: MergeMate finds open-source issues that fit a developer's skills, explains the codebase like a senior dev, preps the fix with them, and turns merged PRs into proof recruiters read. The mark should feel friendly, confident and dev-native, and avoid the stock git-branch icon every dev tool uses.
criteria: Success: ownable among dev tools, holds at 16 px, works in one colour, carries the existing lime + ink equity.

concepts.name: Merge m
concepts.idea: A lowercase m whose two arches share one stem, landing on a commit node: two arches, one merge.
rationale: Initial and merge in one form, so it doesn't look like the stock git icon
Bold arches match the heavy Bricolage wordmark
Pixel-tuned favicon cut holds at 16 px
Lime tile + ink mark carries the site's existing palette

recommendation: Final direction: Merge m. Lime #d4ff3a with ink #0b0d02, wordmark in Bricolage Grotesque Bold, outlined.
next_steps: Swap the in-app LogoMark and favicon
